d:
I spent 10 days investigating modern Britain, speaking to people across classes and professions to uncover the truth. What I discovered was beyond anything I expected. This trip broke a lot of myths I had about developed economies. Through conversations with everyone from bankers to struggling NHS nurses, I uncovered how even the world's richest places can fall apart.
Whether you're curious about global economics or considering moving to the UK, this video reveals the good, the bad, and the ugly of a former empire's transformation.
